headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a thrilling 2-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Simeon Woods Richardson earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save. In other action, the New York Mets took down the Atlanta Braves 8-5, led by Brett Baty's home run and four RBIs. The Minnesota Twins also secured a 9-5 win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Boston Red Sox second baseman Isiah Kiner-Falefa has also been moved to the 60-day injured list. Other notable injuries include New York Yankees right-handed pitcher Kervin Castro, Cincinnati Reds right-handed pitcher Hunter Greene, Toronto Blue Jays right-handed pitcher Jameson Taillon, Miami Marlins first baseman Kyle Stowers, San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac, and Colorado Rockies right fielder Tyler Freeman.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.

top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Andrew Painter earning the win.
